text:
anya: Quick postmortem follow-up from the streaming/chat outage earlier — collecting owners and timelines for the remediation items we committed to. I'll drop a short list here, please react with :white_check_mark: if you own it or @mention someone who does.

leo: I can take the reconnect/backoff tuning work. plan is: add jittered exponential backoff, cap retries per-session, and instrument attempt counts. target: 2w to staging rollout.

maria: I'll own the 'partial-response' detection alerts. Will add a predicate in stream-monitor that flags >10% partials per minute and link to session IDs. two-day ETA for alert + dashboard.

tess: I'll do the client-side resume handshake doc updates and sample SDK snippet for JS + Python. ETA: 4 days.

le o: @maria can you add the alert to the 'streaming-ops' dashboard and include an example query? I want to hook automated runbook links.

maria: yes — will include query + runbook link. also adding an automated ticket creation rule (if 3 consecutive 5min windows breach) -> INC ticket. devops-bot: created ticket INC-4201 for alert onboarding.

devops-bot: Ticket INC-4201 created and assigned to monitoring team. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4201

anya: For the runtime-side mitigation: we discussed a fallback policy to route to shorter-context model variant when streams stall for >8s. Who can prototype?

leo: I'll prototype a policy in the router that looks at per-request last-byte ts and switches to model-x-small after 2s of idle tokens. won't be perfect but should reduce user perp failures. 1 week prototype.

maria: reminder — make sure the fallback preserves any function-calling metadata so downstream tooling still behaves.

tess: on SDK snippet I'll include reconnect + resume + chunk-replay example. also add a caution about not re-sending prompts if resume succeeded.

anya: Ownership recap (putting what I heard):
- Reconnect/backoff tuning: leo — 2w to staging
- Partial-response alerts + dashboard + ticket rule: maria — 2d
- SDK docs + handshake snippet: tess — 4d
- Router fallback prototype: leo — 1w
- Runbook + incident play: anya (I'll draft after dashboards land) — 3d

leo: Adding technical notes: will add config knobs: `max_retries_per_session`, `initial_backoff_ms`, `max_backoff_ms`, `jitter_factor`. default safe values and can be overridden per-tenant.

maria: Also adding a metric `stream.resume.success_rate` and `stream.partial.rate` so we can correlate regressions after changes.

anya: recurring pattern note — this is the 3rd partial/timeout spike in the last 90 days (see incident-archive). propose we schedule a monthly reliability retro focused on streaming telemetry. who wants to join the recurring 1hr sync?

leo: put me on the recurring. prefer weekly for two weeks post-rollout, then monthly.

tess: I'll join the first two.

maria: count me in for the first retro and the dashboard review session.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 2024-06-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. Non-breaking changes are expected.

anya: next steps: I'll create a single tracking ticket that links INC-4201, router prototype PR, SDK PR, and the runbook draft. Will ping owners in the ticket and set an action review in 7 days.

leo: sending a short checklist to the ticket with testing steps: local reconnect sim, long-tail socket stall sim, and canary on 10% of traffic.

maria: once alerts are live I'll trigger a test by replaying historical spike data into stream-monitor.

tess: FYI: I'll also add a short snippet for ops teams on how to temporarily raise `max_backoff_ms` if we see false positives during rollout.

anya: thanks — if anyone needs help with prioritization or we need additional heads, call it out here. closing this thread after I create the tracker. :thumbsup:

leo: :thumbsup:

maria: :white_check_mark:

tess: :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: Tracking ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4202 (streaming-stability-followthrough)
